title: Responsible AI: Spot Bias and Missing Perspectives | Ep 35
description:
Responsible AI: Spot Bias and Missing Perspectives. Learn with a simple example and a beginner exercise.

AI for Beginners — Episode 35 of 50

What you will learn: Test outputs for stereotypes and missing perspectives.
Example: an AI-generated hiring job description.
Try it: rewrite biased wording inclusively.
Remember: training data can encode unfair patterns.
